limits: Callback receipt is an upper bound including host scheduling, not a GPU timestamp.
Timeline runs deliberately refresh after close; failed short/idle budget checks are preserved and excluded from performance conclusions.
Immediate and coalesced callback builds are separate experiments; compare conditions within each binary.
Two full repetitions per initial condition and one corrected pair do not establish stable population statistics.
Virtual region retirement remains unassigned to exact driver/heap calls. No product default selected.
CPU/GPU composition proof is separate, not a change in the standard-load drawing semantics.
